newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Hotung's placement shares oversubscribed - Peregrine.
newsitem.headline: Hotung's placement shares oversubscribed - Peregrine.

text.p: Taiwan's Hotung Investment Holdings' placement tranche of 193.9 million shares at US$0.26 each has been oversubscribed, placement agent and lead manager Peregrine Capital Ltd said on Monday.
"The placement shares have been over 10 times subscribed," Dafney Phua, Peregrine's director of International Equity Offerings Group, told Reuters.
Hotung, a venture capital investment group, announced its initial public offer totalling 242.4 million shares at US$0.26 each on Monday.
The offer includes a public tranche of 48.5 million shares.
Phua said the placement shares were snapped up within a week of its marketing and attracted investors from Asia, the United States and elsewhere.
